Sundh center, also known as Aaltohuset, in Avesta. The building was built by the engineer, master builder and local businessman Ernst Sundh after drawings by architect Alvar Aalto 1957-1961. The character of the façade is characterised by the azure hard burned ceramic rods from Arabia in Finland. The building originally housed business premises, offices, dwellings and in a bottom plan a petrol mack. by unknown, CC0 1.0 (https://www.europeana.eu/item/602/S_DM_photo_DMTB000000229); Dalarnas Museum via Europeana
